#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int from, to;
    int capacity;
    int cost;
    int flow = 0;
    Edge *complement = nullptr;

    Edge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost): from(from), to(to), capacity(capacity), cost(cost) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge*>> compileWD(int n, vector<Edge>& edges) {
    vector<Edge> new_edges = edges; // clone edges
    for (int i = (int)edges.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        Edge &origin = edges[i];
        Edge clone(origin.to, origin.from, origin.capacity, -origin.cost);
        clone.flow = 0;
        clone.complement = &origin;
        origin.complement = &clone;
        new_edges.push_back(clone);
    }
    vector<vector<Edge*>> g(n);
    std::vector<int> p(n, 0);
    for (auto &e : new_edges) p[e.from]++;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i].resize(p[i]);
    std::vector<int> p2 = p;
    for (auto &e : new_edges) {
        g[e.from][--p2[e.from]] = &e;
    }
    return g;
}

long long solveMinCostFlow(vector<vector<Edge*>> &g, int source, int sink, long long all) {
    int n = g.size();
    long long mincost = 0;
    std::vector<int> potential(n, 0);
    std::vector<int> d(n);
    struct cmp {
        bool operator()(int a, int b) {
            return d[a] > d[b];
        }
    };
    std::priority_queue<int, std::vector<int>, cmp> q;
    while (all > 0) {
        std::vector<Edge*> inedge(n, nullptr);
        std::fill(d.begin(), d.end(), INT_MAX/2);
        d[source] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) q.pop();
        q.push(source);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int cur = q.top(); q.pop();
            if (d[cur] != d[cur]) continue; // safeguard
            for (auto *ne : g[cur]) {
                if (ne->capacity - ne->flow > 0) {
                    int nd = d[cur] + ne->cost + potential[cur] - potential[ne->to];
                    if (d[ne->to] > nd) {
                        inedge[ne->to] = ne;
                        d[ne->to] = nd;
                        q.push(ne->to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (inedge[sink] == nullptr) break;
        long long minflow = all;
        long long sumcost = 0;
        for (Edge* e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            if (e->capacity - e->flow < minflow) minflow = e->capacity - e->flow;
            sumcost += e->cost;
        }
        mincost += minflow * sumcost;
        for (Edge* e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            e->flow += minflow;
            e->complement->flow -= minflow;
        }
        all -= minflow;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            potential[i] += d[i];
        }
    }
    return mincost;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;
    string s_str; s_str.resize(n); cin >> s_str;
    vector<char> s(s_str.begin(), s_str.end());

    vector<int> f(26, 0);
    for (char c : s) f[c-'a']++;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        if (f[i] > n/2) {
            cout << -1 << "\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }

    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cin >> a[i];

    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; i++) {
        if (a[i] > a[n - 1 - i]) {
            std::swap(a[i], a[n - 1 - i]);
            std::swap(s[i], s[n - 1 - i]);
        }
    }

    vector<Edge> es;
    int src = n, sink = n + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; i++) {
        es.emplace_back(src, i, 1, 0);
        es.emplace_back(n - 1 - i, sink, 1, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j < n/2; j++) {
            if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - j]) {
                es.emplace_back(i, n - 1 - j, 1, i == j ? 0 : a[i]);
            }
        }
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int val : a) ans += val;

    auto g = compileWD(sink + 1, es);
    long long min_cost = solveMinCostFlow(g, src, sink, n);
    cout << ans - min_cost << "\n";

    return 0;
}
